text:
Marta: Quick note from the demo chaos: gateway waited on admission and we surfaced a flurry of 503s. We should stop blocking the fast-path on long admission reconciles.
Devon: Can you paste the logs? I want to see whether it was token checkout or lease reconciliation.
Marta: snippet:
```
2026-05-10T21:11:02Z ingress-gw WARN req=rio hold=admission wait=1040ms
2026-05-10T21:11:02Z admission-svc ERR req=rio reconcile=slow
2026-05-10T21:11:02Z ingress-gw ERR req=rio respond=503
```
Sam: Two candidate domain boundaries: (A) gateway early-fast-fail when admission is slow (keeps p99 tight), (B) gateway accepts TEMPORARY grants (short TTL) and admission reconciles async. Both affect fairness differently.
Nina: I like TEMPORARY grants but we must bound blast radius. Suggest TEMPORARY only for low-cost routes (embeds, small prompts) and cap per-tenant provisional rate.
Amin: Billing question: charge immediately or after reconciliation? Charging later is accurate but invites complexity. Charging on issue + reconciled refunds seems operationally simpler.
Devon: Proto sketch (different naming):
```
message RateGrant { enum Mode { ACCEPT=0; TEMPORARY=1; DENY=2 } Mode mode = 1; string grant_id = 2; int32 ttl_ms = 3; int32 priority_hint = 4; }
```
Marta: Gateway behavior: if TEMPORARY -> allow request, tag telemetry temporary=true, route to low-priority queue (so we can preempt if admission later revokes). Also maintain in-gateway short cache key=(tenant,route) TTL=600ms to reduce stampedes.
Sam: Reconciliation: admission will emit Confirm or Revoke for grant_id. On Revoke we emit provisional_revoke counter and run a refund batch. Revoke handling should not retroactively terminate already-served responses (too complex) but mark tenant for review and adjust billing.
Nina: Fairness: provisional counts should be included in per-tenant shaping windows. If a tenant uses too many TEMPORARY grants, admission lowers provisional TTL or denies further temporaries.
Amin: Telemetry plan: temporary_issued, temporary_revoked, temporary_ttl_hist, reconcile_refunds_total, per-route latency with temporary tag; alerts for temporary_revoked_rate > X%.
Devon: Ops canary: staging smoke -> 1% prod (low-cost routes) for 24h -> 5% for 48h -> evaluate fairness metrics. Also run synthetic burst sims to validate.
Marta: Action items: Marta RFC+proto, Devon gateway + cache, Sam reconcile+refund pipeline, Nina telemetry/dashboards, Amin simulator. I'll open the RFC and tag owners. :thumbsup:
